It also highlights the focused U.S. market exposure of small caps as a potential advantage in current trade environments.

title: The Owner of the New York Stock Exchange Is Getting Into Bitcoin Futures
summary: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), owner of the New York Stock Exchange, is launching Bakkt, a new crypto trading platform supported by Microsoft, Starbucks, and other major firms. Bakkt aims to enable consumers and institutions to buy, sell, store, and spend digital assets globally. This move will place ICE in competition with CME Group and Cboe Global Markets, expanding the rapidly maturing market for digital assets.

title: Is Apple now too big to fail?
summary: This article discusses Apple Inc. reaching a $1 trillion valuation, highlighting the immense power accumulated by a few tech giants and the lack of scrutiny they face. It draws parallels to the "too big to fail" concept from the banking crisis, arguing that the collapse of these tech companies would have disastrous economic and social consequences. The author urges for greater accountability through legal and economic means.

title: IBM’s Rometty Could Be Next Female CEO to Leave
summary: This article discusses the potential departure of IBM CEO Virginia Rometty, following news of PepsiCo CEO Indra Nooyi's exit. Rometty's position is seen as precarious due to IBM's weak financial results, slow adoption of cloud computing, and a significant underperformance of its stock compared to the S&P 500 and rival tech giants like Amazon and Microsoft. The article suggests that performance, rather than age or retirement, will be the driving factor behind her potential departure.

title: Rentokil robot Trevor kills off mundane processes
summary: Rentokil has deployed a group of software robots, collectively named "Trevor", to automate mundane financial and business process tasks, aiming to improve efficiency and free up human staff for more critical work like training. The pest control firm, in partnership with AI firm Thoughtonomy, has already automated several processes, such as credit checking and sales ledger entries, and plans to expand the use of AI. This initiative is part of Rentokil's strategy to maintain a low-cost operating model while providing excellent customer service and fostering a learning organization approach.

title: Oracle Accused of Defrauding Investors on Cloud Sales Growth
summary: Oracle Corporation is facing a class-action lawsuit led by the City of Sunrise Firefighters' Pension Fund, alleging the company misled investors about the growth drivers of its cloud sales. The lawsuit claims Oracle used coercive tactics to sell cloud products, leading to an unsustainable growth model and subsequent stock plummet. Oracle denies the allegations, stating the suit has no merit.

title: Qualys and IBM X-Force Red join forces to empower organisations
summary: Qualys and IBM X-Force Red have partnered to enhance vulnerability management services for organizations globally. IBM X-Force Red will utilize the Qualys Cloud Platform, including Cloud Agents and Cloud Apps, to identify, prioritize, and remediate critical vulnerabilities across client environments. This collaboration aims to provide a cost-effective and automated approach to security, extending visibility into IoT, network, and application testing.

title: Brazilian banking customers targeted by IoT DNS hijacking attacks
summary: A DNS hijacking campaign has been discovered targeting Banco de Brasil and Itau Unibanco customer credentials through end-user IoT devices like modems and routers. Radware researchers found that malicious DNS servers redirect users seeking financial sites to phishing sites without their awareness. This unique attack focuses on compromising IoT device owners directly rather than using botnets for other common malicious activities.

title: Intapp Acquires DealCloud
summary: Intapp, a leading provider of industry solutions for the professional services industry, announced the acquisition of DealCloud, which specializes in CRM and deal management for investment banking and private equity firms. This acquisition aims to expand Intapp’s Industry Cloud for the professional and financial services markets by combining innovative technology with deep sector expertise. The collaboration will create a comprehensive, cloud-based client lifecycle platform to manage client relationships across the professional and financial services transaction ecosystem.

title: Global Gaming Audio Leader Turtle Beach Unveils Plans For PC Gaming Market Expansion With All-New Atlas Line Of Headsets
summary: Turtle Beach Corporation announced its expansion into the PC gaming market with the new Atlas line of headsets, designed in collaboration with leading esports teams. The Atlas line includes three models: the Elite Atlas Pro Performance Gaming Headset, the Atlas Three Amplified PC Gaming Headset, and the Atlas One PC Gaming Headset, with prices ranging from $49.95 to $99.95. This move leverages Turtle Beach's strong position in the console gaming headset market and aims to attract both dedicated and cross-platform PC gamers.

title: Circle K & Monster Beverage Launch Ultimate Fan Sweepstakes
summary: Circle K Stores Inc. has partnered with Monster Beverage Corp. as the exclusive sweepstakes sponsor for the "Ultimate Fan Challenge" related to the Ultimate Fighting Championship. The sweepstakes will award 300 winners with prizes including the "UFC 3" game, Monster Energy-branded MMA gloves, or a uff.tv pay-per-view pass, entered by purchasing two Monster Energy SKUs. This follows a previous MMA-related sweepstakes collaboration between Circle K and Monster Energy, and PepsiCo's Gatorade is also running a sports-themed sweepstakes at Circle K.

title: Why cyber security is a solid investment theme
summary: The article highlights cyber security as a robust investment theme, driven by the explosion of data and the increasing sophistication of cyber threats. Raj Lala, President and CEO of Evolve ETFs, discusses the rationale behind the Evolve Cyber Security Index ETF (TSX: CYBR), emphasizing that cyber security spending is non-discretionary for organizations despite economic downturns. The ETF invests in global companies offering hardware, software, and consulting services, reflecting strong demand due to a shortage of in-house human capital in the cyber security field.

title: NVIDIA RTX Platform Brings Real-Time Ray Tracing and AI to Barrage of Blockbuster Games
summary: NVIDIA announced that its RTX platform, featuring real-time ray tracing and AI capabilities, is being adopted by top game developers for a host of blockbuster games, including Battlefield V and Shadow of the Tomb Raider. The Turing architecture's RT Cores enable realistic shadows, reflections, and global illumination, while Tensor Cores power Deep Learning Super-Sampling (DLSS) for improved rendering. This advancement brings industry-standard real-time ray tracing and AI to gaming, marking a significant leap in graphical fidelity.

title: Martech and Beer: Bubbles, Sales and Growth – Part 1
summary: This article revisits a 2015 prediction comparing the growth of marketing technology to the craft brewing industry, updating the numbers for vendors and breweries. It analyzes two forces affecting the martech and sales technology (MarSaleStack) markets: the availability of cheap money and market fatigue, finding that neither has significantly slowed growth. The author concludes that while buyers are becoming more selective, money continues to flow into profitable ventures and tech budgets are increasing.

title: 3 lessons we can learn about investing from the DealCloud acquisition
summary: The article discusses three investing lessons from the acquisition of Charlotte-based software company DealCloud by Intapp. It highlights how local angel investors initially missed the opportunity, the fact that early-stage capital raising isn't a guaranteed predictor of success, and the importance of achieving significant value with minimal capital for a successful outcome. The piece also reflects on the growth of the Charlotte startup ecosystem.

title: Q&A: Rapid7 CEO Corey Thomas on Cybersecurity, Privacy, and the Corporate World's Challenges
summary: Rapid7 CEO Corey Thomas discusses the state of cybersecurity, emphasizing that society deploys technology faster than it can manage it, leading to numerous vulnerabilities. He highlights the need for fundamental security practices for individuals, such as using password managers and two-factor authentication, and reviewing privacy settings. Thomas notes that while progress in corporate and government cybersecurity is being made, it's not fast enough to keep up with existing risks.

title: 10 Great Tech ETFs to Buy Now
summary: This article identifies 10 excellent technology-focused ETFs for investors, ranging from broad-based funds to those specializing in specific tech subsectors like cybersecurity, cloud computing, and robotics. It highlights the significant role of the information technology segment within the S&P 500 and provides details on each ETF's holdings, expense ratios, and investment focus.

title: China’s Belt and Road Initiative Opens Up Unprecedented Opportunities - U.S. Global Investors - Commentaries
summary: This article contrasts the economic policies of the U.S. and China, highlighting China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) as a significant global infrastructure and trade endeavor. It details how the BRI is expanding China's influence, particularly in Africa and Eastern Europe, and discusses the implications for commodities markets. The author also analyzes China's economic strength despite trade tensions and investor interest in Chinese equities.

title: Cisco a Better Bet Than Apple, Amazon, Tech Giants: Piper Jaffray
summary: Piper Jaffray's Chief Market Technician Craig Johnson argues that Cisco Systems (CSCO) is a better investment than tech giants like Apple (AAPL) and Amazon (AMZN), which may need a pullback. Johnson suggests buying Cisco due to its recent breakout from a consolidation range, anticipating a run to the $51-$52 range. He views Cisco as a value play, currently trading under $50 with a modest market capitalization.

title: Mobile Native Advertising – How to Boost Signups (and Revenue!) for Your Mobile App
summary: This article discusses how mobile native advertising can help boost app signups and revenue. It highlights five key reasons for its effectiveness: combating banner blindness, facilitating user discovery, enabling compelling storytelling, precise audience targeting, and the use of native video ads. The article uses Blinkist as a case study to demonstrate the success of native advertising on the Outbrain platform.

title: Report: 87 companies control world agricultural production
summary: A new report, the Agrifood Atlas, reveals that 87 corporations worldwide control the global agribusiness supply chain, encompassing a wide range of companies from beverage and meat-packing giants to technology firms. This concentration of market power, especially among four major traders (ADM, Bunge, Cargill, Louis Dreyfus Company), is leading to increasing monoculture, threatening food sovereignty, degrading land, and causing social conflicts. The report also highlights the financialization of agricultural commodities, where speculative trading far outweighs actual production, further exacerbating these issues.

title: Escorts introduces automated concept tractor
summary: Escorts Ltd introduced an automated concept tractor equipped with next-generation digital vehicle technologies for precision-based farming. The company has partnered with several technology giants including Microsoft, Reliance Jio, and Trimble to integrate autonomous applications, remote vehicle management, and data-based soil and crop management solutions. This initiative aims to transform agricultural practices and improve returns for farmers.

title: Gartner Hype Cycle for Data Management Positions Three Technologies in the Innovation Trigger Phase in 2018
summary: Gartner's 2018 Hype Cycle for Data Management identifies DataOps, private cloud database platform as a service (dbPaaS), and machine learning (ML)-enabled data management as entering the Innovation Trigger phase. This indicates these technologies are generating significant interest, with a strong focus on execution and cloud-first delivery models in the data management space. The report highlights that while DataOps and ML-enabled data management are in nascent stages, dbPaaS is rapidly approaching mainstream adoption, especially for organizations with specific security or regulatory needs.

title: Time Magazine Is Bought by Marc Benioff, Salesforce Billionaire (Published 2018)
summary: Marc Benioff, the co-founder of Salesforce, and his wife, Lynne, have agreed to purchase Time magazine from Meredith Corporation for $190 million. This acquisition marks another instance of a tech billionaire investing in an iconic media brand, following Jeff Bezos's purchase of The Washington Post and Laurene Powell Jobs's stake in The Atlantic. The Benioffs emerged as the preferred buyers due to their commitment to journalistic integrity amidst the struggles faced by the magazine industry.

title: Infosys Consulting buys Finnish Salesforce partner Fluido Oy for €65 million
summary: Infosys Consulting has acquired Finnish Salesforce partner Fluido Oy for €65 million, significantly expanding its Salesforce footprint and presence in the Nordics. Fluido Oy's founder and CEO, Kai Mäkelä, highlighted that the deal enables global scalable services, leverages Infosys's deep industry expertise, and maintains Fluido Oy's unique culture and brand autonomy. This acquisition strengthens Infosys's position as a leading Salesforce enterprise cloud services provider and deepens its market presence in the Nordic region.

title: Amazon to Launch 8 New Alexa-Powered Devices: Report
summary: Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN) is reportedly planning to launch at least eight new Alexa-powered smart home devices, including a voice-controlled microwave oven, an amplifier, and an in-car gadget. This expansion is expected to intensify competition with rivals like Apple, Alphabet, and Microsoft in the smart speaker market, and marks Amazon's significant entry into the home appliance space. The move aligns with CEO Jeff Bezos's vision of integrating Alexa more deeply into everyday life, further expanding Amazon's presence in the smart home ecosystem.

title: Sandy Murti
summary: Impinj, Inc. announced the promotion of Sandy Murti to Vice President Global Partner Development. In this role, Murti will lead a multidisciplinary team and drive an integrated approach to partner engagement. He brings extensive experience from previous roles at Impinj, Caradigm, Microsoft, Philips, and Epic.

title: Adobe closing in on acquisition of software company Marketo for about $5 billion, sources say
summary: Adobe was nearing an acquisition of marketing software company Marketo for approximately $5 billion, according to sources. This deal would be Adobe's largest acquisition ever and would help them better compete with Salesforce in the marketing automation space. Vista Equity Partners had acquired Marketo for about $1.8 billion in 2016.

title: Semi-national bank, with $22 billion in assets, relies on area tech unit
summary: Bank OZK, a $22 billion Arkansas-based bank, relies heavily on its St. Petersburg tech unit, OZK Labs, for innovative financial technology. OZK Labs focuses on creating practical applications to improve customer experience, increase efficiency, and gain a competitive edge in the evolving banking industry. The unit's success, including patents and a partnership with Google, has made it a national leader in fintech.

title: Adobe, Microsoft and SAP announce the Open Data Initiative to empower a new generation of customer experiences
summary: Adobe, Microsoft, and SAP have announced the Open Data Initiative to help companies gain a single, comprehensive view of their customer data. This collaboration aims to eliminate data silos, enabling businesses to leverage AI and advanced analytics for real-time insights and to deliver personalized customer experiences. The initiative enhances interoperability between their platforms and includes a common data model based on Microsoft Azure.

title: Formjacking: Major Increase in Attacks on Online Retailers
summary: Symantec has observed a significant rise in formjacking attacks since mid-August 2018, blocking almost a quarter of a million instances. These attacks, often carried out by the group Magecart, target online retailers by injecting malicious JavaScript to steal credit card details, with high-profile victims including Ticketmaster and British Airways. The article details how formjacking works, the scale of recent campaigns, and strategies for protection against these sophisticated threats, particularly supply chain attacks.

title: Qualys Introduces Assessment and Monitoring for the CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark
summary: Qualys has announced the introduction of assessment and monitoring for the CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark within its Cloud Security Assessment (CSA) Cloud App. This new offering helps organizations leveraging Microsoft Azure to integrate security into their DevOps initiatives by automating compliance monitoring and providing remediation steps for misconfigurations and non-standard deployments. The solution aims to help security and DevOps teams continuously identify and manage risks in their Azure cloud environments, ensuring a secure baseline configuration.

title: Infosys wins $700 million contract from Verizon
summary: Infosys has secured two IT outsourcing deals worth over $1 billion in the past two months, including a $700 million contract from Verizon and a $300 million deal from Microsoft. These wins signal improved business performance under CEO Salil Parekh. The Verizon deal involves application development & management (ADM) services and business process management (BPM) services, while the Microsoft deal focuses on order management and support.

title: Walmart, Sam’s Club Start Mandating Suppliers Use IBM Blockchain
summary: Walmart and Sam's Club are mandating that their suppliers of fresh, leafy greens implement real-time, end-to-end traceability using IBM's blockchain technology, starting in September 2019. This initiative aims to speed up responses to foodborne illnesses and recalls, with plans to expand the mandate to other fruit and vegetable providers within a year. The move signals a significant commercial adoption of IBM's blockchain services, with over 100 companies initially required to participate.

title: Compass Announces $400 Million in Series F Funding
summary: Compass, a real estate technology company, announced a $400 million Series F financing round led by Softbank Vision Fund and Qatar Investment Authority. This funding brings their total capital raised to nearly $1.2 billion and will be used for international expansion, U.S. growth, and further technology investment. The company aims to achieve 20% market share in the top 20 U.S. cities by 2020 and continue building its agent productivity platform.

title: After reportedly butting heads with Larry Ellison, Oracle's top cloud executive is leaving the company
summary: Oracle's top cloud executive, Thomas Kurian, has officially resigned from the company after reports of disagreements with co-founder Larry Ellison over cloud strategy. Kurian's departure follows a temporary leave of absence and comes as Oracle's cloud strategy faces challenges and increased competition from rivals like Amazon Web Services and Microsoft. Kurian had a significant role in attempting to transition Oracle to the cloud era over his two decades at the company.

title: Foursquare Raises $33 Million From Investors Including Simon Ventures
summary: Foursquare has closed $33 million in funding from investors including Union Square Ventures, Naver Corp., and Simon Ventures. The funding is intended to support Foursquare's strategic partnerships and expansion, particularly in retail, dining, and media publishers, and growth in Asia. The company's focus remains on leveraging its location-driven datasets to help businesses understand consumer behavior.

title: Digital Deals: Amazon backs prefab smart builder, Procore acquires BIManywhere
summary: This article details recent digital deals in the construction technology space, including Procore's acquisition of BIManywhere to enhance its VDC investments and Amazon's significant investment in Plant Prefab, a sustainable smart home builder. It also covers Guardhat's $20 million Series A funding for its smart safety hardhats and a partnership between PCL Construction and Microsoft to develop a cloud-based construction management app.

title: Staring down IP theft lawsuit, synthetic biology company seeks $86 M IPO
summary: Twist Bioscience, a synthetic biology company backed by Illumina, is seeking an $86 million IPO despite being embroiled in a significant intellectual property theft lawsuit with Agilent. The company, known for its unique deal with Microsoft to store data in DNA, is a rare example of a life sciences IPO with existing revenue.

title: Never Say Never – WWE® 2K19 Available Now; Take the WWE 2K19 Million Dollar Challenge* Beginning This Tuesday, October 9
summary: 2K announced the worldwide availability of WWE 2K19 to Early Access customers, featuring an expanded roster, new gameplay improvements, and fan-favorite modes. The game also introduces the WWE 2K19 Million Dollar Challenge, giving players a chance to win one million dollars by defeating AJ Styles in-game. Notable features include the return of Daniel Bryan's Showcase Mode, an extensive MyCAREER narrative, and new game modes like WWE Towers, alongside a curated soundtrack and various downloadable content options.

title: This foundation plans to store data in DNA on the moon
summary: The Arch Mission Foundation plans to store vast amounts of human knowledge in synthetic DNA molecules and send them to the Moon. This initiative, a collaboration with Microsoft and Twist Bioscience Corporation, aims to preserve information for millions of years. The initial payload will include 20 books and 10,000 crowdsourced images, with future plans to distribute copies across the solar system.

title: HPE: Hybrid Cloud Data Protection and Copy Data Management Solutions for Nimble Storage and 3par
summary: HPE has introduced new hybrid cloud data protection and copy data management solutions for its storage portfolio, including Nimble Storage and 3PAR. These solutions aim to enhance operational efficiency, accelerate cloud backups, and reduce storage costs through innovations like the next-gen StoreOnce appliances, Recovery Manager Central 6.0, and integration with Commvault software, all available through consumption-based IT models like GreenLake Backup. The offerings are designed to address the challenges of data growth and evolving SLA requirements by providing intelligent, multi-tiered data protection from on-premises to the public cloud.

title: Blackbaud and Microsoft expand partnership with an integrated cloud initiative for nonprofits
summary: Blackbaud and Microsoft announced an expanded Integrated Cloud Initiative for Nonprofits, building on their 2017 partnership. The first phase introduces Nonprofit Resource Management (NRM), a specialized suite designed to help nonprofits, especially those in humanitarian aid and relief, manage and distribute resources more efficiently. This initiative aims to accelerate digital transformation in the nonprofit sector by combining Blackbaud's solutions with Microsoft Dynamics 365, leveraging the Common Data Model for Nonprofits and Blackbaud's Intelligence for Good, all powered by Microsoft Azure.

title: How Nokia Bounced Back (With the Help of the Board)
summary: This article details how Nokia recovered from its mobile-phone downfall by undertaking a radical strategic shift towards telecommunications networks, culminating in the US$16.6 billion acquisition of Alcatel-Lucent. The turnaround was significantly aided by Nokia's revamped board of directors, which focused on repairing deep-seated cultural problems and managing the emotional dynamics of its top management to facilitate strategic changes. The board's unique role in emotional regulation allowed managers to consider new strategies and eventually divest the mobile phone business, leading to the company's resurgence.

title: Insight - Amazon scraps secret AI recruiting tool that showed bias against women
summary: Amazon's secret AI recruiting tool, developed since 2014, was scrapped after it showed bias against women. The system, trained on overwhelmingly male-submitted resumes, penalized resumes containing "women's" and downgraded graduates of all-women's colleges, indicating the limitations and inherent biases that can arise in machine learning when historical data is not neutral. Despite efforts to neutralize specific terms, executives lost hope in the project by 2017, highlighting the challenges in creating fair and unbiased AI for hiring.

title: Wall Street closes lower amid fears over trade, oil and rates – as it happened
summary: Wall Street closed lower despite an earlier rally, as fears over US-China trade tensions, rising US interest rates, and the disappearance of Saudi journalist Jamal Khashoggi weighed on markets. Technology stocks were particularly affected, and the article also highlights the jump in America's budget deficit and warnings about an upcoming global economic downturn. European markets also saw declines, though the FTSE 100 managed a modest recovery.

title: Paul Allen Dies at 65
summary: Microsoft co-founder and former Charter Communications chairman Paul Allen passed away at 65 due to complications from non-Hodgkin's lymphoma. Allen, who co-founded Microsoft with Bill Gates, was also a prominent figure in the cable industry through his purchase of Charter Communications and a dedicated philanthropist. Tributes from Bill Gates, his sister Jody Allen, Michael Powell of NCTA, Senator Patty Murray, Charter Communications, and Jeff Bezos highlighted his impactful career and philanthropic efforts.

title: Adobe XD now lets you prototype voice apps
summary: Adobe XD is integrating voice app prototyping capabilities, powered by its acquisition of Sayspring. This allows designers to create voice-based applications for platforms like Alexa and Google Home, as well as mobile apps with voice input, mimicking real user experiences with voice triggers and speech playback. Additionally, XD is receiving other new features such as a full range of plugins, auto-animate, drag gestures, and deeper integration with Adobe Illustrator and After Effects.

title: Tech Moves: Expedia hires Cortana design lead; Saykara adds VP of growth
summary: This article reports on significant personnel changes in the Pacific Northwest tech community. Sam Moreau, a former Microsoft design leader, has joined Expedia as VP of design operations for the Expedia Group brand team. Additionally, Saykara, a Seattle health tech company, appointed Ryan Plasch as its new vice president of growth, following a recent $5 million funding round.

title: Twilio Announces the General Availability of Flex, Fueling the Next Generation of the Contact Center
summary: Twilio announced the general availability of Twilio Flex, its fully programmable cloud contact center platform. This platform offers a new approach to contact centers with flexible pricing starting at $1 per agent hour and has already been adopted by companies like Lyft, U-Haul, and Shopify. Flex allows businesses to customize every element of their contact center experience, integrate with existing systems, and leverage AI for automation.

title: Global Software Vendors Reap Rewards with Oracle Cloud
summary: Oracle announced that Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) globally are rapidly adopting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure to run their enterprise and cloud-native applications, benefiting from mission-critical performance and security. Leading brands like FICO, FireEye, KNAPP, and Manhattan Associates have publicly endorsed Oracle Cloud Infrastructure for powering their market-leading cloud solutions. This adoption has resulted in quicker time to market, faster customer onboarding, cost savings, and enhanced reliable secure services for ISVs.

title: Former Intermedia Exec Eric Martorano To Lead Accordo Group
summary: Eric Martorano, formerly of Intermedia and Microsoft, has been appointed CEO and a board member of Accordo Group, a software asset management company. He aims to expand Accordo's global presence, particularly in the U.S. market, and strengthen its relationship with Microsoft. Martorano also plans to investigate building out a direct-to-channel program for Accordo.

title: iShares Global Tech ETF
summary: This article provides a comprehensive profile of the iShares Global Tech ETF (IXN), detailing its performance, holdings, expense ratio, and ESG scores. It highlights IXN as an option for investors seeking global technology sector exposure, noting its reasonable liquidity and average expense ratio compared to alternatives. The fund's top holdings, geographic exposure, and technical indicators are also discussed.

title: Schwab U.S. Large-Cap ETF
summary: The Schwab U.S. Large-Cap ETF (SCHX) tracks the Dow Jones U.S. Large-Cap Total Stock Market Index, offering exposure to large-cap American companies. It is considered a safe equity play on "Blue Chip" stocks, suitable for investors seeking broad mega and large-cap exposure with low costs. The fund is highly diversified, holding over 750 securities, and can serve as a core building block for many portfolios due to its focus on established, profitable companies.

title: Daz Nabbed in Cloud Services Growth Play
summary: Accenture Technology Solutions acquired El Segundo-based Daz Systems Inc., a cloud service provider specializing in Oracle cloud services, in a "nine-figure" deal. The acquisition aims to significantly strengthen Accenture's Oracle cloud business and expand Daz's local operations. Daz, founded in 1995, generates approximately $50 million in annual revenue and has implemented Oracle cloud systems for over 500 clients.

title: Invesco MSCI USA ETF
summary: The Invesco MSCI USA ETF (PBUS) tracks a U.S. large- and mid-cap equity index, excluding small-caps, making it comparable to an S&P 500 ETF. It is part of Invesco’s low-cost PureBeta lineup, offering competitive fees. The fund has attracted significant assets, but its daily trading volume is lower than some longer-established large-cap U.S. equity ETFs.

title: Invesco S&P 500® Downside Hedged ETF
summary: The Invesco S&P 500® Downside Hedged ETF (PHDG) is an actively managed fund designed to provide exposure to rising equities while hedging against market downturns using VIX-linked derivatives. The fund aims to outperform during market declines but may lag during stable bullish periods due to the cost of maintaining VIX hedges. PHDG is priced reasonably for an active strategy, and investors are encouraged to compare its performance against low-cost S&P 500 index funds.

title: Fidelity Nasdaq Composite Index ETF
summary: This page provides a detailed profile of the Fidelity Nasdaq Composite Index ETF (ONEQ), including its price, performance metrics, holdings, expense ratio, and ESG scores. The ETF tracks the NASDAQ Composite Index, offering exposure heavily tilted towards technology and U.S. equities, making it suitable for investors seeking substantial tech sector exposure or as a complementary portfolio holding. It also compares ONEQ's valuation, dividend, and various performance indicators against its peers in the Large Cap Growth Equities category.

title: Motley Fool 100 Index ETF
summary: This page provides a comprehensive profile of the Motley Fool 100 Index ETF (TMFC), detailing its pricing, holdings, performance, and operational metrics. It includes data on its expense ratio, inception date, top holdings like NVIDIA and Apple, and various analytics such as concentration, valuation, and dividend information. The report also covers ESG scores, geographic exposure, and technical indicators for the ETF.

title: Fidelity Low Volatility Factor ETF
summary: The Fidelity Low Volatility Factor ETF (FDLO) tracks an index of large- and mid-cap U.S. stocks with lower susceptibility to market swings, offering a low-volatility tilt for U.S. equity allocations. It holds over 100 securities and is reasonably priced for its segment. The article details its holdings, performance, expenses, liquidity, and ESG scores.

title: Global X NASDAQ 100 Covered Call ETF
summary: The Global X NASDAQ 100 Covered Call ETF (QYLD) utilizes a covered call strategy by buying stocks in the Nasdaq 100 index and selling corresponding call options to generate income. This ETF is suitable for investors seeking added yield from Nasdaq stocks with some downside protection, offering an alternative to direct options trading. It provides detailed financial data, performance metrics, and ESG scores for informed investment decisions.

title: Fidelity Dividend ETF for Rising Rates
summary: The Fidelity Dividend ETF for Rising Rates (FDRR) tracks an index of large and mid-cap developed market stocks selected for their dividend-paying and growth potential, and their positive correlation with increasing 10-year U.S. Treasury yields. This ETF aims to protect investors from rising interest rates, which typically negatively impact traditional dividend-paying stocks and bond funds. FDRR's portfolio is primarily composed of U.S. stocks and is suited for investors looking for a dividend-focused tilt in their portfolio.

title: Invesco RAFI US 1000 ETF
summary: The Invesco RAFI US 1000 ETF (PRF) tracks a fundamentally-weighted index based on book value, cash flow, sales, and dividends, differentiating it from market capitalization-weighted funds. It offers exposure to large U.S. equities with significant holdings in financials and industrials/energy. The article provides detailed performance metrics, holdings analysis, expense ratios, and ESG scores for PRF, comparing it against peer ETFs in the Large Cap Blend Equities category.

title: iShares Expanded Tech Sector ETF
summary: This article provides a detailed profile of the iShares Expanded Tech Sector ETF (IGM), offering exposure to the U.S. tech sector with a focus on companies like Broadcom, NVIDIA, and Microsoft. It includes performance data, holdings analysis, expense ratios, ESG scores, and technical indicators. While suitable for tactical tilts, its concentration in tech giants might overlap with existing portfolio holdings for long-term investors.

title: Core Banking Software Market Is Booming Worldwide |SAP SE, Oracle, Infosys, FIS
summary: HTF Market Intelligence Consulting Pvt. Ltd. has released a new study on the Global Core Banking Software Market, providing an in-depth overview and market outlook to 2023. The report segments the market by key regions, types (Software & Services), and applications (Retail Banks, Private Banks, Corporate Banks & Others), highlighting key players such as SAP SE, Oracle, Infosys, and FIS. The study forecasts market size and growth opportunities, alongside competitive analysis and regional performance.

title: iShares U.S. Tech Independence Focused ETF
summary: This page provides a comprehensive profile of the iShares U.S. Tech Independence Focused ETF (IETC), detailing its current price, dividend information, expense ratio, and a list of its top holdings. It also includes performance comparisons against peers, technical analysis, and ESG scores, giving a thorough overview for potential investors. The fund is actively managed and primarily invests in U.S. large-cap technology equities.

title: ProShares Ultra QQQ
summary: The ProShares Ultra QQQ (QLD) is an ETF designed for sophisticated investors seeking 2x daily long leverage to the NASDAQ-100 Index. It is categorized as a Leveraged Equities ETF with a 0.95% expense ratio and has an AUM of $12.8 billion. The article provides detailed performance metrics, holdings, volatility analysis, and ESG scores, emphasizing its suitability for short-term bullish outlooks on technology equities.

title: JPMorgan Dividend Leaders ETF
summary: The JPMorgan Dividend Leaders ETF (JDIV) tracks a rules-based index that selects high-yielding stocks based on volatility and yield, holding over 200 stocks across various market caps. While competitively priced, it faces competition from less expensive rivals and lags in assets and liquidity. The ETF's profile includes detailed financial data, holdings, performance metrics, and ESG scores, making it a comprehensive resource for investors interested in dividend-focused equity exposure.

title: Fidelity High Dividend ETF
summary: The Fidelity High Dividend ETF (FDVV) tracks an index of large- and mid-cap developed market stocks that pay high dividends, appealing to investors seeking steady income. While it focuses heavily on North American equities with about 100 securities, it may not offer broad diversification across global developed markets. The article provides detailed information on its profile, performance, holdings, expenses, and ESG scores.

title: Invesco NASDAQ Internet ETF
summary: The Invesco NASDAQ Internet ETF (PNQI) invests in large, liquid companies involved in internet-related businesses, primarily U.S.-listed but offering global exposure. The ETF significantly allocates to technology and consumer cyclical sectors, targeting firms across various market capitalizations for growth potential. It currently holds top positions in companies like Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, and Microsoft, and has an expense ratio of 0.60%.

title: IBM to Acquire Red Hat for About $33 Billion
summary: IBM announced its acquisition of Red Hat Inc. for approximately $33 billion, marking its largest acquisition to date. This strategic move aims to strengthen IBM's cloud-computing business, which CEO Ginni Rometty sees as crucial for the company's revival. The deal positions IBM to better compete in the evolving cloud market, especially in providing hybrid services that leverage both on-premise and multiple cloud resources.

title: Microsoft again recognized as a Leader in Gartner Magic Quadrant for Content Services Platforms
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in Gartner's Content Services Platforms Magic Quadrant for the second consecutive year, placing highest in Ability to Execute. The company emphasizes SharePoint's role as the content services platform for Microsoft 365, supporting diverse content types, integrating with other Microsoft services, and highlighting significant growth in active users and data stored. Microsoft is also noted as the only company recognized as a leader in both Content Collaboration Platforms and Content Services Platforms Magic Quadrant reports.

title: 8x8 buys Jitsi open source video conferencing from Atlassian
summary: 8x8 has acquired Jitsi, an open source video conferencing company, from Atlassian to enhance its 8x8 Meetings platform. This move aims to improve 8x8's competitive standing against rivals like RingCentral and expands its business communications portfolio beyond cloud telephony. The acquisition also brings Jitsi's engineering team to 8x8, with Jitsi's open source platform remaining available for developers.

title: LinkedIn Offers New Integrations with Google Campaign Manager and Vimeo
summary: LinkedIn has announced new integrations designed to enhance marketers' capabilities. One integration is with Google Campaign Manager, allowing for better comparison and management of LinkedIn ad performance alongside other ad efforts in a single dashboard. Additionally, Vimeo now offers a new way for paid subscribers to publish videos directly to their LinkedIn company pages, making it easier to share video content and leverage LinkedIn's high member engagement.

title: Momentum Investing: It Works, But Why?
summary: Momentum investing, a strategy of buying recent stock winners and selling recent losers, has consistently generated above-average returns for decades, challenging the efficient market hypothesis. Despite its proven success, academics, including UCLA Anderson's Avanidhar Subrahmanyam, are still trying to definitively explain why it works. The article explores various behavioral theories, such as investor overreaction or underreaction to information, and calls for more focused research to narrow down the true driving factors.

title: DXC Pushes For ServiceNow Dominance With TESM, BusinessNow Acquisitions
summary: DXC Technology announced the acquisition of two leading ServiceNow partners, TESM and BusinessNow, to strengthen its ServiceNow business and practice. These acquisitions are part of DXC's strategy to become a dominant player in the ServiceNow ecosystem, following other recent partner acquisitions in the industry. The deals aim to leverage the ServiceNow platform for enterprise-wide digital transformation across clients in Europe, the UK, and globally.

title: Advanced Micro Devices stock jumps after getting chip order from Amazon
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock rose after Amazon.com Inc.'s cloud unit announced it would use AMD's Epyc data center chips for its services. This move is expected to boost AMD's revenue growth within its Enterprise, Embedded and Semi-Custom business. AMD shares climbed 2.13% in premarket trading, following a 3.92% increase the previous day, while Amazon shares also saw a premarket rise.

title: Gap Inc. Accelerates Digital Transformation with Microsoft Cloud
summary: Gap Inc. announced a strategic partnership with Microsoft Corp. to accelerate its digital transformation and enhance customer experiences across its brands. Microsoft will serve as Gap Inc.'s primary cloud provider, utilizing Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 to deploy new business capabilities and improve organizational efficiency. This collaboration aims to scale technology securely to accommodate growth in value and active business, particularly online and mobile.

title: Germany's SAP to Buy Qualtrics for $8 Billion in Cash
summary: SAP SE announced its largest acquisition to date, purchasing Qualtrics International Inc. for $8 billion in cash. This strategic move aims to bolster SAP's presence in the fast-growing customer relations management (CRM) sector, where it competes with rivals like Salesforce.com Inc. The acquisition is seen as an effort to accelerate growth by expanding SAP's software offerings.

title: Corsair Gaming Mice, Keyboards Now Work With Xbox One
summary: Corsair has announced that several of its keyboards and mice are now compatible with Xbox One S and Xbox One X consoles, capitalizing on Microsoft's expanded peripheral support. This partnership aims to bridge the gap for console players who prefer keyboard and mouse input, with titles like Fortnite, Warframe, and Minecraft already supporting the new input. Corsair also highlighted how this collaboration will benefit Mixer streamers through Elgato Stream Deck integration.

title: Exclusive: Cloud Securer Netskope Raises $170 Million, Sprouts ‘Unicorn’ Horn
summary: Netskope, a cloud security firm, has raised $169 million in a new funding round, valuing the company at over $1 billion and admitting it to the "unicorn club." The company, which helps secure data and cloud infrastructure for a quarter of the Fortune 100, has raised a total of $400 million to date. Netskope plans to invest heavily in R&D, sales, marketing, and potential acquisitions, with an IPO in its trajectory.

title: Corsair's gaming keyboards and mice are now compatible with the Xbox One
summary: Corsair has announced that its range of gaming keyboards and mice will support the Xbox One, following Microsoft's recent announcement of keyboard and mouse compatibility for the console. This partnership makes Corsair an Xbox licensed hardware partner, allowing gamers to use their peripherals on select Xbox One titles. Additionally, Corsair's Elgato Stream Deck can now be integrated with Microsoft's Mixer live streaming service.

title: Oracle veteran Thomas Kurian to head Google Cloud
summary: Thomas Kurian, a former Oracle Corp product chief, will replace Diane Greene as the head of Google Cloud. Kurian, who spent 22 years at Oracle, resigned in September and will join Google on November 26th. This leadership change occurs as Google Cloud aims to expand its enterprise business and compete with rivals like Amazon.com Inc and Microsoft Corp.

title: Google hires former Oracle exec Thomas Kurian to be new cloud CEO
summary: Former Oracle Corp product chief Thomas Kurian is set to replace Diane Greene as the head of Alphabet Inc's Google Cloud division. Greene announced her departure, stating she would move into investing and philanthropy after three years at Google. Kurian's appointment comes after a challenging year for Google Cloud, including employee protests over military contracts and a withdrawal from bidding on a major defense cloud computing contract.

title: Unlocking Industry 4.0 with Cutting-Edge Technologies
summary: This article explores the transformative impact of technologies like AI, Robotics, IoT, and Blockchain on Industry 4.0, particularly in energy and commodities. It discusses the evolution of Commodity/Energy Trading and Risk Management (C/ETRM) systems and the potential of blockchain to introduce transparency, liquidity, and efficiency. The piece also addresses the challenges and the strategic approach required for successful blockchain implementation, emphasizing the need to understand its true capabilities and manage expectations.

title: Marc Benioff defends Salesforce’s contract with Customs and Border Protection
summary: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff defended his company's contract with U.S. Customs and Border Protection amidst criticism from employees and others concerned about the agency's role in family separation. Benioff emphasized the launch of an Office of Ethical and Humane Use of Technology to guide the company's approach to the use of its software. He highlighted that tech companies are entering a "new world" where the ethical use of their technology, whether by government or corporations, needs constant examination.

title: Chatbots for Insurance – Progessive, Allstate, GEICO, and More
summary: This article explores the growing role of chatbots in the insurance sector, highlighting initiatives from major insurers like Progressive, Allstate, and GEICO. It examines the types of chatbot applications currently in use, the tangible results they've driven, and common trends in InsurTech. The report also details the technologies behind these chatbots and offers takeaways for business leaders in the insurance industry.

title: Google’s new cloud CEO is Thomas Kurian
summary: Thomas Kurian has been appointed as the new CEO of Google Cloud, succeeding Diane Greene. Kurian, formerly a key executive at Oracle, is tasked with bolstering Google Cloud's market share against competitors like AWS and Microsoft by positioning Google as a serious enterprise player. His background and industry contacts are expected to be valuable assets in attracting large companies to Google's cloud infrastructure.

title: Egyptian transportation startup Swvl raises tens of millions in Series B at valuation close to $100 million, plans expansion to Southeast Asia
summary: Egyptian transportation startup Swvl has raised tens of millions in its Series B round, valuing the company close to $100 million, making it a first for an Egyptian company with publicly disclosed data. The funding, co-led by Dubai-based BECO Capital, Africa-based DiGAME, and Silicon Badia, will fuel Swvl's expansion into Southeast Asia, targeting megacities in the Philippines, Vietnam, and Thailand, and establishing an R&D facility in Berlin. Swvl aims to become a multi-billion dollar tech company focused on solving commuting challenges in emerging markets through its app-based bus booking service.

title: IBM Stock History: 1 Chart You Have to See
summary: This article examines IBM's long history as a blue-chip stock, tracing its evolution from its origins to its current state. It highlights IBM's challenges in adapting to mobile and cloud computing revolutions, which led to underperformance, but also notes the emerging growth in its "strategic imperatives." The author suggests that despite current struggles, IBM's financial resources and research capabilities make it an interesting long-term investment.

title: Examining Gartner's 2018 Magic Quadrant for Cloud ERP for Product-Centric Midsize Enterprises
summary: This article examines Gartner's 2018 Magic Quadrant for Cloud ERP for Product-Centric Midsize Enterprises, highlighting key takeaways from Gartner's first such report for cloud ERP suites for product-centric companies. It details Gartner's definition of product-centric cloud ERP solutions, lists the 14 vendors included in the Magic Quadrant, and provides insight into the significant growth and generational technology shift occurring in the ERP market, particularly toward cloud deployments. The report emphasizes that ERP represents the largest category of enterprise software spending, projected to grow through 2022.

title: Applying Newton’s First Law of Motion to an ETF
summary: This article discusses the Fidelity Momentum Factor ETF (FDMO), an exchange-traded fund that invests in large and mid-cap companies demonstrating positive momentum, applying Newton's First Law of Motion to investing. The ETF's strategy is based on the theory that stocks in motion tend to stay in motion, aligning its investments with top-performing sectors like information technology and financials. It highlights FDMO's performance, expense ratio, yield, current assets, and top holdings, suggesting it for investors who believe recent upward trends will continue.

title: AWS Takes Aim at Oracle & Microsoft – With Telco Assistance
summary: AWS CEO Andy Jassy positioned AWS as a superior alternative to Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, citing customer dissatisfaction with proprietary and expensive systems. Globe Telecom's CIO, Pebbles Sy-Manalang, supported this by detailing their successful migration from Oracle to AWS, which resulted in significant cost savings and performance improvements. The article highlights Amazon Web Services' strategy to move away from relational databases towards specialized databases and cloud-native solutions, leveraging telecommunication companies' transformations.

title: Bitten by wanderlust, driven by technology - Arvind Nithrakashyap's journey to Rubrik
summary: This article chronicles the journey of Arvind Nithrakashyap, co-founder and CTO of Rubrik, highlighting his two-decade-long love affair with databases, his significant contributions at Oracle including co-founding the Exadata product line, and his passion for travel. It details his transition from established tech companies to the startup world, his role in the founding and growth of Rubrik, and his philosophy on technology and decision-making.

title: Microsoft surpasses Apple as most valuable U.S. company
summary: Microsoft Corp. officially retook its title as the most valuable U.S. company by market capitalization on Friday, unseating Apple Inc. after more than two years. Microsoft's market cap closed at $851.22 billion, while Apple's was $847.43 billion. This marks the first time in 15 years Microsoft has held this position.

title: [Update: Google's Response] Cheetah Mobile is accused of committing Ad Fraud in several apps
summary: Cheetah Mobile and Kika are accused of ad fraud by Kochava, alleging that some of their popular Android apps claim referral bonuses without directly contributing to app installations. Google has responded by removing two of the implicated apps, CM File Manager and Kika Keyboard, from the Play Store and AdMob network. This incident highlights concerns about user data exploitation and deceptive practices within the app ecosystem.

title: Baidu Leads AI Patent Applications In China With 2,368 Filings
summary: Baidu leads in AI patent applications in China, filing 2,368 patents, surpassing companies like the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Microsoft, Tencent, and Samsung. The search engine giant also leads in four key AI areas including natural language processing and autonomous driving. This surge in AI patent applications reflects tech firms' efforts to protect their breakthroughs in the rapidly growing field.

title: Google, IBM, Oracle to Talk Tech at White House Amid Trade War
summary: Technology industry leaders from Google, IBM, Oracle, Microsoft, and Qualcomm are set to attend a White House summit to discuss emerging innovations like artificial intelligence. The meeting takes place against the backdrop of the administration's ongoing trade war with China. Attendees include Sundar Pichai, Ginni Rometty, Safra Catz, Satya Nadella, and Steve Mollenkopf.

title: Embedded Systems in Automobile Market: Developing Trends, Cost Structure Analysis and Threats Faced By Key Vendors (Atmel, Infineon Tech., Infosys, Microsoft, Texas Instruments, HCL) | Global Forecast to 2025
summary: A new report, "Global Embedded Systems in Automobile Market Research Report 2018," analyzes the embedded systems market in the automotive industry, forecasting a healthy growth rate from 2018 to 2025. Key drivers include increasing demand for electric vehicles, advanced safety systems, and vehicle electrification, with the APAC region estimated to hold the largest market share in 2017. The report identifies major players, product types, and regional market dynamics, providing insights for informed decision-making.

title: Taking aim at Intel, Qualcomm launches chip for business PCs
summary: Qualcomm has launched a new series of chips, the Snapdragon 8cx, specifically designed for business PCs to directly compete with Intel. These new chips will support Windows 10 Enterprise, addressing a limitation of previous Qualcomm chips that only supported consumer versions of Windows. This move intensifies Qualcomm's competition with Intel, which has historically dominated the PC chip market and is also being challenged in the data center business.

title: Building a More Just Marketplace: The 2018 Rankings of America’s Most JUST Companies
summary: This report details JUST Capital's 2018 rankings of America's Most JUST Companies, identifying corporations that excel in areas important to the American public, such as fair pay, environmental impact, and community support. The rankings highlight that JUST 100 companies outperform their peers financially and socially, with Microsoft topping the list. The article emphasizes how these rankings can guide consumers and investors toward businesses driving a more just economy.

title: DXC Technology to open two new Analytics Migration Factories
summary: DXC Technology is expanding its analytics migration operations by opening two new Analytics Migration Factories in Manila, Philippines, and Warsaw, Poland. These new facilities follow the success of its first factory in Bangalore, India, and aim to help clients accelerate their migration of data and analytics environments to Microsoft Azure. DXC will invest in training its professionals in these locations to enhance skills in data science, cloud architecture, and solution deployment on Microsoft Azure, leveraging its Bionix model for intelligent automation.

title: Adobe Named The Best Tech Company to Work For in India List
summary: Adobe has been named the top tech company to work for in India in a 2018 report by job search portal Indeed, followed by Nvidia and Microsoft. The report highlights that Indian job seekers prefer large international firms for career advancement and work exposure in the technology sector. Multinational corporations dominated the list, reinforcing the demand for such companies in India's job market.

title: Yahoo parent Verizon cuts value of media brands by $4.6bn
summary: Verizon has slashed the collective value of its digital media brands, including Huffington Post, Yahoo, and AOL, by $4.6 billion, reducing Oath's worth to approximately $200 million. This write-down reflects challenging conditions for digital media companies, a stark contrast to their earlier valuations, and signals difficulties for Verizon's ambition to rival Google and Facebook. The struggling valuations of other digital media companies like Vice Media and BuzzFeed are also highlighted, suggesting a trend of consolidation.

title: Psst, Parents! Target's New Toy Space Is Honestly A Holiday Dream Come True
summary: Target is enhancing its toy departments in nearly 600 stores by adding more space, interactive displays, and exclusive toy selections, doubling its offerings from the previous year. This move, partly influenced by the exit of Toys "R" Us, aims to attract holiday shoppers through in-store events and an improved online experience, including 22 million gift catalogs. The company is focusing on both physical and digital strategies to cater to its "littlest guests" and drive sales.

title: What’s Changed: 2018 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Master Data Management Solutions
summary: Gartner, Inc. has released its 2018 Magic Quadrant for Master Data Management Solutions, evaluating 14 providers based on their ability to execute and completeness of vision. The report highlights changes in vendors, with Contentserv, Reltio, Semarchy, and Viamedici added, and Oracle removed. Informatica and Orchestra Networks remain leaders, while SAP is a top challenger, and new players like Semarchy and Profisee are making strides in the market.

title: Innoviz Expands Globally, Sets Up Commercial Manufacturing Line in China
summary: Israel-based LiDAR startup Innoviz Technologies Ltd. has announced a new 4,000 square meter facility in China to enable commercial manufacturing of its sensor by the end of next year. The company also opened new offices in the U.S., Germany, China, and Japan, doubling its employee count in the past year and planning further recruitment for R&D and business development. Innoviz's LiDAR systems are designed for autonomous vehicles, and their product was selected by BMW for serial production starting in 2021.

title: Tesla names close Musk friend Larry Ellison to board
summary: Tesla appointed Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison and Kathleen Wilson-Thompson to its board, aiming to satisfy U.S. regulators' demands for independent oversight following Elon Musk's tweets about taking the company private. Ellison, a close friend and shareholder of Musk, and Wilson-Thompson, Walgreens Boots Alliance's global head of HR, join the board amidst investor concerns about corporate governance. This move follows an SEC settlement requiring Tesla to add independent directors and control Musk's communications.

title: CyberArk Sees Opportunity in Small and Medium Businesses
summary: CyberArk, originally focusing on large corporations, is now targeting small and medium businesses with a cloud-based "light" version of its cybersecurity services. CEO Udi Mokady explains that while big cloud vendors provide infrastructure, customers remain responsible for data security, creating a market opportunity. The company has seen significant growth since its 2014 Nasdaq listing and has made several strategic acquisitions, many with ties to the Israeli tech ecosystem.
